scope: Vaporize observes source-declared versions for active Apple apps at private/apple/apps/<app> and product-lines/<product-line>/apps/<app>, including evaluated Pkl composition entrypoints.
toolingBoundary: The focused test establishes scanner behavior and the Pkl command establishes entrypoint evaluation. The version-status report remains source-only and does not prove generated-project parity, Xcode execution, installed-runtime parity, release, or human approval.
claims: A product-line app home is recognized without relocating it to private/apple/apps.
A payload-free project.pkl entrypoint may compose a versioned Pkl carrier and be evaluated as the active source carrier.
Unreadable Pkl source is reported as a finding rather than silently omitted or inferred from generated Xcode state.
